fields.q: 前几天我买了个可爱的首饰盒！可惜太便宜，第二天就坏了。
fields.en: I bought a cute accessory case the other day! But it was cheap, and it broke the next day.
fields.name: 哈尔温

q.value: 前几天我买了个可爱的首饰盒！可惜太便宜，第二天就坏了。

en.value: I bought a cute accessory case the other day! But it was cheap, and it broke the next day.

fields.q: 我很擅长手工。也许可以试着用鸟的羽毛做点东西。
fields.en: I'm good at crafts. I ought to try making something with bird feathers, maybe.
fields.name: 哈尔温

q.value: 我很擅长手工。也许可以试着用鸟的羽毛做点东西。

en.value: I'm good at crafts. I ought to try making something with bird feathers, maybe.

fields.q: 我看到魔术师凭空在手上变出一只鸟！我也想试试。你能变小吗？
fields.en: I saw a magician make a bird appear in their hand from nowhere! I want to try it. Can you shrink?
fields.name: 哈尔温

q.value: 我看到魔术师凭空在手上变出一只鸟！我也想试试。你能变小吗？

en.value: I saw a magician make a bird appear in their hand from nowhere! I want to try it. Can you shrink?

fields.q: 我打仗不如大家厉害，但也许能在别的方面派上用场，对吧？
fields.en: I can't fight as well as everybody else, but I can maybe be useful in other ways, right?
fields.name: 哈尔温

q.value: 我打仗不如大家厉害，但也许能在别的方面派上用场，对吧？

en.value: I can't fight as well as everybody else, but I can maybe be useful in other ways, right?

fields.q: 我喜欢做甜点。改天也给你做点甜的吧。
fields.en: I like making sweets. Maybe I could make something sweet for you sometime.
fields.name: 哈尔温

q.value: 我喜欢做甜点。改天也给你做点甜的吧。

en.value: I like making sweets. Maybe I could make something sweet for you sometime.

fields.q: 纳西姆以前很照顾我。他人好好。我现在有时还会想起他……
fields.en: Nasshim used to take care of me. He was so nice. I still think about him sometimes…
fields.name: 哈尔温

q.value: 纳西姆以前很照顾我。他人好好。我现在有时还会想起他……

en.value: Nasshim used to take care of me. He was so nice. I still think about him sometimes…

fields.q: 我在构思下一场表演，要是我们一起变个戏法，大家一定会喜欢。
fields.en: I've been thinking about my next performance, and I think people would love it if we did a trick together.
fields.name: 哈尔温

q.value: 我在构思下一场表演，要是我们一起变个戏法，大家一定会喜欢。

en.value: I've been thinking about my next performance, and I think people would love it if we did a trick together.

fields.q: 一想到将来，我总会担心那些自己无能为力的事。
fields.en: When I think about the future, I always end up worrying about stuff I can't do anything about.
fields.name: 哈尔温

q.value: 一想到将来，我总会担心那些自己无能为力的事。

en.value: When I think about the future, I always end up worrying about stuff I can't do anything about.

fields.q: 不管离开多久，一想到家人和家乡，我就好寂寞。
fields.en: It doesn't matter how long I'm gone, thinking of my family and my hometown makes me feel so lonely.
fields.name: 哈尔温

q.value: 不管离开多久，一想到家人和家乡，我就好寂寞。

en.value: It doesn't matter how long I'm gone, thinking of my family and my hometown makes me feel so lonely.

fields.q: 蔬菜嘛，我觉得味道比卖相重要，你说呢？
fields.en: I think taste is more important than looks when it comes to vegetables, don't you?
fields.name: 哈尔温

q.value: 蔬菜嘛，我觉得味道比卖相重要，你说呢？

en.value: I think taste is more important than looks when it comes to vegetables, don't you?
